question.text: Will a Préfecture de Police curfew be in effect anywhere in Paris on the night of New Year's Eve 2026?
question.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves as Yes if the Paris Préfecture de Police issues an [order](https://www.emploi-collectivites.fr/arrete-blog-territorial) for a curfew in any part of the City of Paris to be in effect at any time from 23:00 local time on December 31, 2026 to 06:00 on January 1, 2027.

The question resolves according to the Préfecture de Police [arrêtés page](https://www.prefecturedepolice.interieur.gouv.fr/actualites-et-presse/arretes/accueil-arretes) or [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print: This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46328) which opened on 2026-10-30 12:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

research:
I found no Préfecture de Police curfew order covering the night of December 31, 2026, and nothing in force in Paris after 06:00 on November 2. Every Paris curfew since the October riots has been a short, renewable order, and none has been issued more than about a day ahead.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-05: I fetched the Préfecture de Police arrêtés page and it came back empty, so I could not see the latest orders there. [PP arrêtés](https://www.prefecturedepolice.interieur.gouv.fr/actualites-et-presse/arretes/accueil-arretes)
- 2026-10-30: The latest curfew order I could confirm is arrêté n° 2026-01485. It applied from 23:00 to 06:00 to everyone inside two zones, around Place de la République and around Les Halles, on the nights of October 31 to November 1 and November 1 to 2. It ended Monday November 2 at 06:00. [laclepublique](https://laclepublique.fr/paris/articles/2026/2026-10-30-couvre-feux-toussaint-paris/), [economiematin](https://www.economiematin.fr/paris-couvre-feu-republique-halles-dimanche-1-novembre-2026)
- 2026-10-29: Arrêté n° 2026-01478 set a curfew for unaccompanied minors, 21:00 to 06:00, in sectors of 12 arrondissements, for three nights from October 30 to November 2. [laclepublique](https://laclepublique.fr/paris/articles/2026/2026-10-30-couvre-feux-toussaint-paris/)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. I found no reporting of any Paris curfew after 06:00 on November 2, 2026, and none announced for New Year's Eve. My searches were thin for November 2 to 5, so a quiet renewal can't be fully ruled out.
- The pattern so far: each order covered one to three nights and was published 1 to 2 days ahead. An order for December 31 would most likely appear only in late December.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-05: Prefect Patrice Faure ordered tighter checks (identity checks, bag and vehicle searches at stations and motorway tolls) for the national strike day. The reports mention no curfew. [Le Parisien](https://www.leparisien.fr/paris-75/greve-du-5-novembre-fouilles-de-sacs-visites-de-vehicules-la-prefecture-de-police-renforce-les-controles-autour-des-gares-et-peages-dile-de-france-05-11-2026-CPDEVQ7FGVCNFE42UXOGX23S7A.php)
- 2026-11-04: The prefecture banned the Bastille-Concorde march route, citing a "very high" threat level and the October 17 riots (855 arrests, more than 30 shops looted). The administrative court upheld the République-Nation route instead. [CNews](https://www.cnews.fr/france/2026-11-04/manifestations-du-5-novembre-la-prefecture-de-police-de-paris-interdit-le)
- 2026-11-03: Student protests resumed after the school holidays. Unions claim more than 500 high schools were blocked; the government puts it at 48. [il manifesto](https://ilmanifesto.it/fine-delle-vacanze-tornano-i-cortei-in-francia-gli-studenti-non-smobilitano)
- 2026-10-28: The Paris administrative court suspended an earlier minors' curfew (October 26 to 29), calling it a serious and manifestly unlawful restriction on freedom of movement. The prefect reissued it the next day, and Vigie Liberté challenged the new order too. I found no ruling on that challenge. [laclepublique](https://laclepublique.fr/paris/articles/2026/2026-10-30-couvre-feux-toussaint-paris/), [Sortiraparis](https://www.sortiraparis.com/en/news/in-paris/articles/356528-curfew-for-minors-in-paris-from-october-30-to-november-2-2026)
- 2026-10-26: The curfew was renewed for that Monday but in only one district, which suggests it was being scaled back. [Sortiraparis](https://www.sortiraparis.com/en/news/in-paris/articles/355062-paris-curfew-extended-again-on-monday-october-26-but-in-just-one-district)
- 2026-10-20: Curfews were announced "for as long as necessary" in Paris and other cities. The first Paris one covered République and Les Halles, 23:00 to 06:00, on the night of October 20 to 21. [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/10/20/france-protests-violence-curfew-paris-looting/1233b5fa-cc86-11f1-ac04-9f58578a68b4_story.html), [Journal du Geek](https://www.journaldugeek.com/2026/10/20/couvre-feu-a-paris-marseille-nice-quartiers-concernes-et-a-partir-de-quelle-heure/)
- 2026-10-19: Curfews began in several cities after the PM asked prefects for highly localized measures. [17 October riots, Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/17_October_riots), [stephanelarue](https://stephanelarue.com/couvre-feu-a-paris-les-halles-et-republique-dans-le-viseur-des-lundi-soir/)

### 4. Base rates
- New Year's Eve 2025-26: the prefecture issued arrêté n° 2025-01692 setting up protection perimeters and other police measures, plus restrictions on fireworks. There was no curfew, and the Champs-Élysées concert was cancelled for security reasons. [paris.fr PDF](https://cdn.paris.fr/paris/2025/12/30/arrete-pp-mesures-de-securisation-31-decembre-2025-meyl.pdf)
- New Year's Eve 2024: again security perimeters and traffic measures only, no curfew. [paris.fr PDF](https://cdn.paris.fr/paris/2024/12/30/cp-pp-29122024-dispositif-de-securisation-et-de-circulation-saint-sylvestre-2024-WXJP.pdf)
- From my own background knowledge, not checked in this session: the only recent Paris New Year's Eve under a curfew was 2020-21 (a national COVID curfew from 20:00, set by government decree rather than a prefecture order). The 2005 state-of-emergency curfews were imposed by prefects in some suburban départements, not in Paris itself.
- The normal pattern is a perimeter and security arrêté published around December 29 to 30, not a curfew. The 2026 situation is unusual: Paris has already had repeated localized curfews from October 19 to November 2. Courts have pushed back on the minors' curfews, but the general 23:00 curfews in République and Les Halles stood as far as I found.

### 5. Other forecasts
- None of the prices supplied (Kalshi and Polymarket markets on football, weather, concerts and so on) relate to this question.
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on a Paris curfew. I could not see the community forecast on the original Metaculus question (46328).

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-05: national strike day, with up to 780,000 protesters expected according to an RTL report of intelligence estimates. Violence could bring curfews back. [BFM.ru](https://www.bfm.ru/news/622917)
- 2026-11-06 and 07: Yellow Vest protests reportedly called; this rests on a single search summary. [vietnam.vn](https://www.vietnam.vn/fr/phap-tai-ap-dung-lenh-gioi-nghiem-tai-khu-vuc-trung-tam-paris)
- Ongoing: student blockades and parliament's 2027 budget debate, which unions oppose.
- Pending court cases: Vigie Liberté's challenge to the minors' curfew. Future rulings will shape what kind of curfew the prefecture can legally order.
- Around 2026-12-23 to 31: the usual New Year's arrêtés (fireworks restrictions, security perimeters), published around December 29 to 30. That is where any New Year's Eve curfew would most likely appear.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 8 weeks remain. The outcome will be known around January 1, 2027. For Yes, the Paris Préfecture de Police must issue an arrêté imposing a curfew (general or minors-only) on any part of the City of Paris, in effect at some point between 23:00 on December 31, 2026 and 06:00 on January 1, 2027.

(b) Status quo: No. No curfew has been in force in Paris since 06:00 on November 2. Recent orders covered one to three nights and were published only 1 to 2 days ahead. The normal New Year's Eve order sets security perimeters and restricts fireworks; it does not impose a curfew.

(c) Base rate: Paris New Year's Eves over roughly the last 20 years show essentially no prefecture curfews. The 2020-21 COVID curfew was a national decree, not a prefecture order. That gives a base rate of about 1 to 2%. A second reference class is French cities that recently used curfews in response to unrest, such as 2005 and the 2023 Nahel riots. Those curfews typically lapsed within weeks and were not revived for New Year's Eve. That supports a low but higher figure, around 5%, given this year's unusual context.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- October 19 to November 2: the prefecture repeatedly showed it is willing to use localized curfews, including reissuing a minors' curfew the day after a court suspended it (October 28 to 29).
- Unrest is ongoing. Student blockades resumed on November 3, there was a large strike on November 5, and the prefect cited a "very high" threat level on November 4.
- New Year's Eve is a known flashpoint, with car burnings at the end of 2025.

Evidence for No:
- Curfews were being scaled back by late October (October 26, a single district) and have lapsed since November 2.
- On October 28 the administrative court called the minors' curfew manifestly unlawful, which raises the legal bar.
- On November 5 the prefecture chose identity checks and searches over curfews.
- The prefecture's normal New Year's Eve tools are perimeters and fireworks bans.

(e) No scenario: protests fade or stay mostly peaceful through November and December, possibly after budget concessions. On December 29 to 30 the prefecture publishes its usual security-perimeter and fireworks arrêté with no curfew.

Yes scenario: a fresh wave of riots in December, perhaps triggered by a police incident or the budget vote, brings localized curfews back. The prefecture extends one, possibly a minors' curfew, to cover New Year's Eve in hotspot zones.

(f) I start from a base rate of about 3%. I move up substantially because curfews were used in Paris only weeks ago, the prefect is clearly willing to use them, and unrest is continuing into a known flashpoint night. I hold back from going higher because the curfews have already lapsed, the courts have resisted them, the prefecture currently prefers other tools, and two months is enough time for de-escalation. The net estimate is about 10%.

Probability: 10%

(a) The outcome will be known around January 1, 2027, about eight weeks from now. For Yes, the Paris Préfecture de Police must issue an arrêté imposing a curfew, either general or minors-only, in any part of the City of Paris that is in effect at some point between 23:00 on December 31, 2026 and 06:00 on January 1, 2027.

(b) Status quo: no curfew has been in force since 06:00 on November 2. The orders were short, renewable and being scaled back to fewer zones and nights. If nothing changes, the answer is No.

(c) Base rate:
- Paris New Year's Eves over roughly the last 20 years: the only one under a curfew was 2020-21, which was a COVID national decree rather than a prefecture order. That gives about 0-5%.
- Recent comparable years also produced security perimeters and fireworks bans only. In 2025-26 there was notable unrest and still no curfew.
- Conditional on a recent wave of riot curfews two months earlier, the rate is higher, but there are almost no precedents. In 2005 the curfews were suburban, ended by early January, and did not cover the city of Paris.
- Starting base rate: about 5%.

(d) Evidence:
- For Yes:
  - The prefect has shown repeated willingness to order curfews (October 19 to November 2), including reissuing a minors' curfew the day after a court suspended it (October 29).
  - Protests are ongoing: school blockades resumed November 3, the November 5 strike was labelled a "very high" threat, and the budget fight continues.
  - New Year's Eve is a known flashpoint.
- For No:
  - The curfews were scaled back from October 26 and none has been found after November 2.
  - The court suspended the October 26 minors' curfew as manifestly unlawful, and a further challenge is pending.
  - The November 5 response used route bans and searches, not curfews.
  - A New Year's Eve curfew in central Paris would clash with mass celebrations, and the normal tool is perimeters.

(e) Scenarios:
- No: the protest movement fades or stays daytime-focused through December. The prefecture issues its usual December 30 security and fireworks arrêté with no curfew.
